fact: Car 18 allegedly left the track at T12 and gained a lasting advantage.
offence: Alleged breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 c) of the International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video and in-car video evidence. Car 18 made a move on Car 2 on the outside into Turn 12. He was in front at the apex and to the exit and therefore had the right to the line. The driver of Car 2 defended his position on the inside, forcing Car 18 slightly off track at the exit. However, due to the track layout in that part of the track, Car 18 was able to stay alongside and maintain his position, essentially resulting in both cars ending up in the correct order. Taking all this into account the Stewards decide to take no further action.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
team: Aston Martin Aramco Cognizant F1 Team
title: Decision Car 18 Alleged Leaving The Track
